title: Toolbar
summary: A row with a lead (title and note) on the left and actions on the right. It wraps by its own width and stacks on a phone, with touch-sized actions.

props.name: heading
props.description: The lead title, in strong text.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted note beside the title, such as a count.

slots.description: More lead content after the title and note (filters, chips).

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons at the right; hidden when empty, full width and touch-sized on a narrow container.

parts.name: lead
parts.description: The title, note and default slot.

a11y: A plain group of controls, not an ARIA toolbar (which would need arrow-key roving): every action is a normal tab stop in reading order. The title is text, not a heading; use pk-page-header when the outline needs one.

examples.title: Title, note and actions
examples.html:
<pk-toolbar heading="Lines" note="12 lines on this order">
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini" variant="ghost">Export</pk-button>
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini">Add line</pk-button>
</pk-toolbar>
